subject.title: Review path for an AIPOU MCP receipt skill with explicit no-hidden-wallet-action rules

question: Should ClawHub allow or recommend an AIPOU-style MCP receipt skill with optional wallet settlement, and if so what exact review evidence, metadata, and receipt/status attachment surface are required?
rationale: This decision affects user trust in wallet/payment-capable third-party content, and current main provides general audit/moderation primitives but no maintainer-approved wallet-settlement boundary.

options.title: Fold Into Policy RFCs First
options.body: Keep this open as a concrete AIPOU test case while maintainers settle the broader vetted-community and crypto/content-policy decisions before adding schema, docs, badges, or recommendation language.

options.title: Approve Local-Receipt Pilot
options.body: Define a temporary local-receipt-only path requiring no primary wallet, no raw prompt upload, no claims by default, explicit claim commands, contract disclosure, and real MCP runtime proof before recommendation.

options.title: Reject Wallet-Capable Recommendations For Now
options.body: State that wallet/settlement-capable AIPOU listings are not eligible for public recommendation until ClawHub has an approved crypto/blockchain exception path.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Policy RFCs First
recommendation.body: Keep this open as a concrete AIPOU test case while maintainers settle the broader vetted-community and crypto/content-policy decisions before adding schema, docs, badges, or recommendation language.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the most relevant policy, docs, schema, CODEOWNERS, and related RFC context for this security-sensitive trust-surface decision.
